name: A Sedentary Fist
source:
This short kinetic novel follows the life of a boy who has lost his way of life - boxing. No longer able to fight, he moves to a new town and hopes to discover the next step he has to take to move forward.

[From [url=https://jamsandwich.itch.io/a-sedentary-fist]itch.io[/url]]
